# slog

Types from the Go package `slog` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## slog.Attr

An Attr is a key-value pair.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `value` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogvalue">Value</a></code> |  |
| `equal()` | <code>(b: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>): boolean</code> | Equal reports whether a and b have equal keys and values. |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> |  |

## slog.Handler

A Handler handles log records produced by a Logger.

A typical handler may print log records to standard error,
or write them to a file or database, or perhaps augment them
with additional attributes and pass them on to another handler.

Any of the Handler's methods may be called concurrently with itself
or with other methods. It is the responsibility of the Handler to
manage this concurrency.

Users of the slog package should not invoke Handler methods directly.
They should use the methods of [`Logger`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger) instead.

Before implementing your own handler, consult https://go.dev/s/slog-handler-guide.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled()` | <code>(_arg0: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, _arg1: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a>): boolean</code> | Enabled reports whether the handler handles records at the given level. The handler ignores records whose level is lower. It is called early, before any arguments are processed, to save effort if the log event should be discarded. If called from a Logger method, the first argument is the context passed to that method, or context.Background() if nil was passed or the method does not take a context. The context is passed so Enabled can use its values to make a decision. |
| `handle()` | <code>(_arg0: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, _arg1: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord">Record</a>): void</code> | Handle handles the Record. It will only be called when Enabled returns true. The Context argument is as for Enabled. It is present solely to provide Handlers access to the context's values. Canceling the context should not affect record processing. (Among other things, log messages may be necessary to debug a cancellation-related problem.) |
| `withAttrs()` | <code>(attrs: Array&lt;<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>&gt;): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloghandler">Handler</a></code> | WithAttrs returns a new Handler whose attributes consist of both the receiver's attributes and the arguments. The Handler owns the slice: it may retain, modify or discard it. |
| `withGroup()` | <code>(name: string): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloghandler">Handler</a></code> | WithGroup returns a new Handler with the given group appended to the receiver's existing groups. The keys of all subsequent attributes, whether added by With or in a Record, should be qualified by the sequence of group names. |

## slog.Level

A Level is the importance or severity of a log event.
The higher the level, the more important or severe the event.

Has everything <code>Number</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns a name for the level. If the level has a name, then that name in uppercase is returned. If the level is between named values, then an integer is appended to the uppercased name. Examples: |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements [encoding/json.Marshaler] by quoting the output of [`Level.string`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel). |
| `unmarshalJSON()` | <code>(data: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | UnmarshalJSON implements [encoding/json.Unmarshaler] It accepts any string produced by [`Level.marshalJSON`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel), ignoring case. It also accepts numeric offsets that would result in a different string on output. For example, "Error-8" would marshal as "INFO". |
| `appendText()` | <code>(b: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | AppendText implements `encoding.textAppender` by calling [`Level.string`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel). |
| `marshalText()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalText implements `encoding.textMarshaler` by calling [`Level.appendText`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel). |
| `unmarshalText()` | <code>(data: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | UnmarshalText implements `encoding.textUnmarshaler`. It accepts any string produced by [`Level.marshalText`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel), ignoring case. It also accepts numeric offsets that would result in a different string on output. For example, "Error-8" would marshal as "INFO". |
| `level()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a></code> | Level returns the receiver. It implements `Leveler`. |

## slog.Logger

A Logger records structured information about each call to its
Log, Debug, Info, Warn, and Error methods.
For each call, it creates a [`Record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord) and passes it to a [`Handler`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloghandler).

To create a new Logger, call `New` or a Logger method
that begins "With".

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `handler()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloghandler">Handler</a></code> | Handler returns l's Handler. |
| `with()` | <code>(...args: any[]): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger">Logger</a>)</code> | With returns a Logger that includes the given attributes in each output operation. Arguments are converted to attributes as if by [`Logger.log`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger). |
| `withGroup()` | <code>(name: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger">Logger</a>)</code> | WithGroup returns a Logger that starts a group, if name is non-empty. The keys of all attributes added to the Logger will be qualified by the given name. (How that qualification happens depends on the [`Handler.withGroup`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloghandler) method of the Logger's Handler.) |
| `enabled()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, level: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a>): boolean</code> | Enabled reports whether l emits log records at the given context and level. |
| `log()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, level: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a>, msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | Log emits a log record with the current time and the given level and message. The Record's Attrs consist of the Logger's attributes followed by the Attrs specified by args. |
| `logAttrs()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, level: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a>, msg: string, ...attrs: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>[]): void</code> | LogAttrs is a more efficient version of [`Logger.log`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger) that accepts only Attrs. |
| `debug()` | <code>(msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | Debug logs at `LevelDebug`. It uses `context.background` internally; to specify the context, use [`Logger.debugContext`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger). |
| `debugContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | DebugContext logs at `LevelDebug` with the given context. |
| `info()` | <code>(msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | Info logs at `LevelInfo`. It uses `context.background` internally; to specify the context, use [`Logger.infoContext`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger). |
| `infoContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | InfoContext logs at `LevelInfo` with the given context. |
| `warn()` | <code>(msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | Warn logs at `LevelWarn`. It uses `context.background` internally; to specify the context, use [`Logger.warnContext`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger). |
| `warnContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | WarnContext logs at `LevelWarn` with the given context. |
| `error()` | <code>(msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | Error logs at `LevelError`. It uses `context.background` internally; to specify the context, use [`Logger.errorContext`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger). |
| `errorContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>, msg: string, ...args: any[]): void</code> | ErrorContext logs at `LevelError` with the given context. |

## slog.Record

A Record holds information about a log event.
Copies of a Record share state.
Do not modify a Record after handing out a copy to it.
Call `NewRecord` to create a new Record.
Use [`Record.clone`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord) to create a copy with no shared state.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `time` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a></code> | The time at which the output method (Log, Info, etc.) was called. |
| `message` | <code>string</code> | The log message. |
| `level` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">Level</a></code> | The level of the event. |
| `pc` | <code>number</code> | The program counter at the time the record was constructed, as determined by runtime.Callers. If zero, no program counter is available. |
| `clone()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord">Record</a></code> | Clone returns a copy of the record with no shared state. The original record and the clone can both be modified without interfering with each other. |
| `numAttrs()` | <code>(): number</code> | NumAttrs returns the number of attributes in the [`Record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord). |
| `attrs()` | <code>(f: (_arg0: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>) =&gt; boolean): void</code> | Attrs calls f on each Attr in the [`Record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord). Iteration stops if f returns false. |
| `addAttrs()` | <code>(...attrs: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>[]): void</code> | AddAttrs appends the given Attrs to the [`Record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord)'s list of Attrs. It omits empty groups. |
| `add()` | <code>(...args: any[]): void</code> | Add converts the args to Attrs as described in [`Logger.log`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogger), then appends the Attrs to the [`Record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord)'s list of Attrs. It omits empty groups. |
| `source()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogsource">Source</a>)</code> | Source returns a new Source for the log event using r's PC. If the PC field is zero, meaning the Record was created without the necessary information or the location is unavailable, then nil is returned. |

## slog.Value

A Value can represent any Go value, but unlike type any,
it can represent most small values without an allocation.
The zero Value corresponds to nil.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogkind">Kind</a></code> | Kind returns v's Kind. |
| `any()` | <code>(): any</code> | Any returns v's value as an any. |
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> | String returns Value's value as a string, formatted like `fmt.sprint`. Unlike the methods Int64, Float64, and so on, which panic if v is of the wrong kind, String never panics. |
| `int64()` | <code>(): number</code> | Int64 returns v's value as an int64. It panics if v is not a signed integer. |
| `uint64()` | <code>(): number</code> | Uint64 returns v's value as a uint64. It panics if v is not an unsigned integer. |
| `bool()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | Bool returns v's value as a bool. It panics if v is not a bool. |
| `duration()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a></code> | Duration returns v's value as a [`time.duration`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration). It panics if v is not a time.Duration. |
| `float64()` | <code>(): number</code> | Float64 returns v's value as a float64. It panics if v is not a float64. |
| `time()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a></code> | Time returns v's value as a [`time.time`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime). It panics if v is not a time.Time. |
| `logValuer()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogvaluer">LogValuer</a></code> | LogValuer returns v's value as a LogValuer. It panics if v is not a LogValuer. |
| `group()` | <code>(): Array&lt;<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogattr">Attr</a>&gt;</code> | Group returns v's value as a []Attr. It panics if v's [`Kind`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogkind) is not `KindGroup`. |
| `equal()` | <code>(w: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogvalue">Value</a>): boolean</code> | Equal reports whether v and w represent the same Go value. |
| `resolve()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogvalue">Value</a></code> | Resolve repeatedly calls LogValue on v while it implements [`LogValuer`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglogvaluer), and returns the result. If v resolves to a group, the group's attributes' values are not recursively resolved. If the number of LogValue calls exceeds a threshold, a Value containing an error is returned. Resolve's return value is guaranteed not to be of Kind `KindLogValuer`. |

## slog.Source

Source describes the location of a line of source code.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `function` | <code>string</code> | Function is the package path-qualified function name containing the source line. If non-empty, this string uniquely identifies a single function in the program. This may be the empty string if not known. |
| `file` | <code>string</code> | File and Line are the file name and line number (1-based) of the source line. These may be the empty string and zero, respectively, if not known. |
| `line` | <code>number</code> |  |

## slog.Kind

Kind is the kind of a [`Value`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogvalue).

Has everything <code>Number</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `string()` | <code>(): string</code> |  |

## slog.LogValuer

A LogValuer is any Go value that can convert itself into a Value for logging.

This mechanism may be used to defer expensive operations until they are
needed, or to expand a single value into a sequence of components.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `logValue()` | <code>(): <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogvalue">Value</a></code> |  |
